DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the penis and finger (multiple primary cutaneous squamous cell carcinomas).

I have noted the high-risk factors including age, smoking history, failed prior treatments, and the specific description of non-healing, crusted lesions on both the penis and the finger.
